items.text: Deep truths about life and reality are:

options.A: Accessible to anyone who sincerely seeks them
options.B: Accessible to most with sufficient effort
options.C: Require some preparation but available to many
options.D: Require special training, insight, or development
options.E: Only accessible to those with special capacities or status

items.text: A guru claims only initiates can understand certain truths. A democrat says truth is equally available to all. Who's right?

options.A: The democrat—truth is available to all sincere seekers
options.B: Mostly the democrat—basic truths are accessible to all
options.D: Mostly the guru—deep truth requires cultivation
options.E: The guru—profound truths require significant development

items.text: Do some truths require special capacities to understand?

options.A: No—this is just gatekeeping and elitism

interpretation.-2: Truth is available to all equally
interpretation.0: Some preparation needed but widely accessible
